text: {"sql": "SELECT false_alarm, shift_code, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE kind = 'machine_overheat' AND ts >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ts < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY false_alarm, shift_code ORDER BY incident_count DESC", "columns": ["false_alarm", "shift_code", "incident_count", "total_downtime_min", "total_cars_lost"], "purpose": "Count machine_overheat incidents by false alarm flag and shift for Jul-Oct 2026, with downtime and cars lost sums."}

data.sql: SELECT false_alarm, shift_code, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE kind = 'machine_overheat' AND ts >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ts < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY false_alarm, shift_code ORDER BY incident_count DESC
data.purpose: Count machine_overheat incidents by false alarm flag and shift for Jul-Oct 2026, with downtime and cars lost sums.
